```{r setup, include = F}
# TODO: Incorporate question numbers into data tables

# Set Options ==================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = '-')

# Import =======================================================================
library(here)
library(openxlsx)
library(srvyr)
library(tidyverse)

casper_clean <- readRDS(here("data/casper_kauai26_recovery_data_clean.rds"))

# Convert to srvyr design
srv_design <- as_survey_design(casper_clean,
                               ids = surv_cluster,
                               weights = surv_weight)

# Worker Functions =============================================================
# Function for getting summaries of factors ------------------------------------
# NOTE: Can only accept 1 variable at a time
summarize_factor <- function(var_name) {
  
  # TODO: Consider keeping NA's, why are we removing?
  #  - How does it handle places where the data are skipped?
  #  - Want to show % of people where whole is number that saw the question
  a <- srv_design %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]))
  
  # Break if all data are NA
  if (nrow(a)==0){
    warning("No non-missing observations for ", var_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Make sure this variable is a factor
  if (!is.factor(pull(a, var_name))) {
    a <- a %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var_name), as.factor))
  }
  
  # Get factor levels for later joining
  level_df <- data.frame(
    Category = levels(pull(a, var_name))
  )
  level_df$Variable <- var_name
  
  a %>%
    # grouping by values in each variable
    group_by(.data[[var_name]]) %>%
    summarize(
      # count of responses for each variable
      Frequency = n(),
      Estimated_HH = round(survey_total(vartype = "var"), 0),
      # Calculates the weighted percentage of the population that falls into this category
      # The vartype = "ci" tells R to automatically calculate the 95% CIs
      Percent = round(
        survey_prop(vartype = c("ci", "se"), 
                    prop_method = "likelihood",
                    proportion = TRUE
                    ) * 100, 
        2)) %>%
    # lists var_names in a column called category
    mutate(Variable = var_name, Category = .data[[var_name]]) %>%
    # Bring in factor levels that may have been blank
    full_join(level_df, by = c("Variable", "Category")) %>%
    mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = level_df$Category)) %>%
    arrange(Category) %>%
    # Only keep wanted cols
    select(Question = Variable,
           Answer = Category,
           N = Frequency,
           `Est HH`=Estimated_HH,
           Pct=Percent,
           `Pct 95CI L` = Percent_low,
           `Pct 95CI U` = Percent_upp,
           `Pct SE` = Percent_se)
}

# Function for getting summaries of numerics -----------------------------------
summarize_numeric <- function(var_name) {
  num_results <- srv_design %>%
    summarize(
      median = survey_quantile(
        .data[[var_name]],
        quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
        na.rm = TRUE,
        vartype = "ci"
      ),
      mean = survey_mean(
        .data[[var_name]],
        vartype = "ci",
        na.rm = T
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      iqr = paste0(median_q25, " - ", median_q75),
      mean = round(mean, 2)
    )
  
  tibble(
    Question = var_name,
    Median = num_results$median_q50,
    `Median 95CI L` = num_results$median_q50_low,
    `Median 95CI U` = num_results$median_q50_upp,
    IQR = num_results$iqr,
    Mean = num_results$mean,
    `Mean 95CI L` = num_results$mean_low,
    `Mean 95CI U` = num_results$mean_upp
  )
}
```

# Demographics

```{r tables}
# Means
demo_n <- c("demo_n_hh", "demo_n_u2", "demo_n_2to17", "demo_n_18to64", "demo_n_65p")
demo_n_table <- map(demo_n, summarize_numeric) %>%
  list_rbind()
knitr::kable(demo_n_table)

demo_factor <- c(
  "demo_hh_infants", "demo_hh_kids", "demo_hh_adults", "demo_hh_elders",
  "demo_own_rent", "demo_langs_cat"
)
# Add individual languages
demo_factor <- c(
  demo_factor,
  names(casper_clean)[str_detect(names(casper_clean), "demo_lang_.*")]
)

demo_table <- map(demo_factor, summarize_factor) %>%
  list_rbind()
knitr::kable(demo_table)
```

# Impact of Hurricane Lowell

**Data interpretation note from the field:** Respondents who reported they were "unsure" about the government response rating question often said they did not feel capable of rating the response because they were minimally affected by the storm. "Unsure" should not be interpreted as they were wavering on whether or not the government did a good job.

```{r hurricane_impact}
# Hurricane impact variables
imp_vars <- c(
  "imp_evacuate", "imp_evacuate_where" ,
  "imp_home_safe", "imp_damage_to_home",
  "imp_damage_report_cnty", "imp_damage_ins_claim",
  "imp_job_loss",
  "imp_neighbors",
  "imp_county_alerts", "imp_trusted_info", "imp_govt_response",
  "imp_unmet_needs", "imp_comm_res_barriers"
)

imp_vars_w_resources <- c(
  imp_vars,
  names(casper_clean)[startsWith(names(casper_clean), "imp_comm_res__")]
)

# Combine results
impact_table <- map(imp_vars_w_resources, summarize_factor) %>%
  list_rbind()
knitr::kable(impact_table)
```

```{r export}
# Put tables into Excel file ---------------------------------------------------
# Combine tables into a list so that each is its own sheet
my_sheets <- list(
  "Numerics"     = demo_n_table,
  "Demographics" = demo_table,
  "Impacts"      = impact_table,
  "Supplies"     = supp_table,
  "Health"       = health_table
)

write.xlsx(my_sheets, file = here("CASPER_Kauai26Recovery_datatables.xlsx"))

# Export tables ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Make column names safe by replacing " " with "_"
saveRDS(srv_design %>% rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, " ", "_")),
        file = here("data/srv_design.rds"))
saveRDS(demo_table %>% rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, " ", "_")),
        file = here("data/demo_table.rds"))
saveRDS(supp_table %>% rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, " ", "_")),
        file = here("data/supp_table.rds"))
saveRDS(impact_table %>% rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, " ", "_")),
        file = here("data/impact_table.rds"))
saveRDS(health_table %>% rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, " ", "_")),
        file = here("data/health_table.rds"))
```
